name: OSH Cut
how_read: Plain HTTPS page fetch, no account, no quote; figures copied as published. Prose quotes are verbatim; 'table_row' quotes name the table, row and cells.
not_read: Per-thickness bend radius, k-factor and minimum flange length: OSH Cut says they are 'in our material catalog' (app.oshcut.com/catalog); that host is not on this session's allowed list, so they were not read.
No published minimum hole size, web, hole-to-edge or hole-to-bend figures on www.oshcut.com (its DFM checks run in the quoting app).
https://www.oshcut.com/design-guide returned 404; the design-guide index is /design-guide/learn-more.
The min/max size page prints a 'Min Size' figure (e.g. 0.1) with no unit; kept as published, not evaluated.

rules.quote: OSH Cut's standard tolerances are +/- 0.005" for most materials and thicknesses.
Our minimum material thickness is 0.02", but varies depending on the material.
OSH Cut offers metal blank cutting in material thicknesses up to 1.0" in steel and aluminum.
OSH Cut offers metal blank cutting in material thicknesses up to 1.0" in steel and aluminum.
We currently offer stainless thicknesses up to 5/8" thick
Our standard bend angle tolerances are +/- 1.0 degree.

rules.note: Gauging-surface recognition is not implemented (gap).
rules.quote: A flat part edge parallel to the bend line, at least 0.25" long for small parts, or

rules.note: Gauge not converted: the page gives no thickness for '18-gauge' (it differs by material).
rules.quote: Typically, as long as the metal is 18-gauge or thicker, the integrity of the hole / depth stop should remain intact.
OSH Cut offers metal tapping in tap sizes ranging from 6-32 to 1 1/2-6 (standard) and M3 x 0.5 to M36 - 4.0 (Metric).
